scope: Current, task-level factual package for the Western Provinces Achievement Diary. It proposes future normalized actions and graph structure only. It does not edit production data, assign priority or scores, determine combat readiness, simulate kill/drop outcomes, or generate a route.

included: quests, locations, access, minigame, encounter, and item gates
consumed, transformed, reusable, and variable inputs
tier rewards and their fixed utility
excluded: kill, crop, minigame, or drop simulation

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: Claiming a tier requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy skill requirements unless a task explicitly says otherwise. Combat-level and item equip requirements are not inferred boostable.
global_rules.observation_boundary: A kill, successful catch, pickpocket, minigame reward, player crop state, chompy/jubbly counter, or other chance-dependent/gameplay result is never inferred from prerequisites. It requires explicit observed or player-confirmed state.
global_rules.claimant: Rewards are claimed from the Elder gnome child just south of the Grand Tree in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

normalization_proposal.rule: Each completed task becomes one action that awards only its durable Western Provinces task milestone. Claim actions require every same-tier milestone and the preceding claimed tier. Fixed inventory transitions may be modeled only where the task supplies exact inputs; dynamic outputs, combat success, minigame points, crop growth, and daily counters remain external observations.
graph_nodes: Zulrah and Thermonuclear Smoke Devil kill observations
graph_edges: each explicit skill, quest, location/access, item, counter, or observed event -> corresponding task action (requires)
each task action -> durable task milestone (produces)
all same-tier task milestones plus prior claimed tier -> tier claim action (requires)
tier claim action -> claimed-tier milestone, banner, lamp selection event, and stated capabilities (produces)
Hard claim -> elite-void-upgrade action (requires); regular Void top/robe plus 200 commendation points per piece -> elite Void top/robe (transforms)
Hard/elite claims -> daily-limited transport, arrow, or resurrection capabilities; cooldown usage remains a future observed time-state transition
normalization_proposal.encounter_boundary: Terrorbird, elf, Zulrah, Thermonuclear Smoke Devil, successful catches/mines/pickpockets, Pest Control point earnings, Gnome Restaurant delivery, chompy thresholds, and account-owned crop status must be player-confirmed or imported account observations. None are auto-completed from their listed requirements.

intentionally_not_modeled_as_actions: farming growth, disease, health, and harvest
daily arrow claims, banner teleports, and Zulrah-resurrection cooldown state

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Zulrah access phrasing
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The current diary task table lists Regicide (started), while the current Zulrah access page describes progression through Regicide to Port Tyras and High Priestess Zul-Harcinqa permission to board. The former is recorded as the diary requirement; the latter is retained as the operative encounter-access gate. Integration should keep both rather than weaken the access condition.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Chompy and jubbly thresholds
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The four hat tasks require observed cumulative thresholds of 30, 125, 300, and 1,000 kills. They do not authorize an action to generate kills, ammunition consumption, hunting success, or a hat automatically.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Pest Control and elite Void
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Diary credit needs a point-earning game at the named lander. Hard-diary completion unlocks elite-void upgrades but does not grant regular Void pieces, commendation points, elite Void, or combat readiness.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Farming tasks
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The Lletya palm task depends on observed account-owned grown-crop state; the Prissy Scilla task records the exact plant/protection transition but not growth or harvest. No crop timer is inferred.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Community sources
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: No community guide, Reddit post, YouTube video, or GitHub project was used for task facts. Current OSRS Wiki sources were preferred; the listed Jagex source is historical reward corroboration only.
